February 10, 2026
The Corporation is serving approximately 191,000 electricity customers.
The BCUC approved a 2025 forecast average rate base of $1,820 million. The updated 2025 forecast average rate base of $1,850 million and a 2026 forecast average rate base of $1,897 million were filed.
